title: The Disease Traced Through a Map
short_teaser: During a nineteenth-century cholera outbreak, John Snow mapped deaths and connected them to a public water pump.
story: During a nineteenth-century cholera outbreak, John Snow mapped deaths and connected them to a public water pump. A pattern became visible when information was placed in relationship to location. Discovery begins when attention stays with what does not fit long enough for a better explanation to emerge. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: A pattern became visible when information was placed in relationship to location. Discovery begins when attention stays with what does not fit long enough for a better explanation to emerge.
